Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, we seek refuge in You

Arabic text: مِنْ نَزَغَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَكَيْدِهِ وَمَكَايِدِهِ
Translation: From the evil suggestions of the accursed Satan, his deceit, and his plots

Arabic text: وَمِنَ الثِّقَةِ بِأَمَانِيِّهِ وَمَوَاعِيدِهِ وَغُرُورِهِ وَمَصَايِدِهِ
Translation: And from trusting in his false promises, his pledges, his delusions, and his snares
And from his ambition to lead us astray
From Your obedience and to humiliate us through disobedience to You

Arabic text: أَوْ أَنْ يَحْسُنَ عِنْدَنَا مَا حَسَّنَ لَنَا
Translation: Or that he makes appealing to us what he has beautified for us

Arabic text: أَوْ أَنْ يَثْقُلَ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَرَّهَ إِلَيْنَا
Translation: Or that he makes burdensome for us what he has made displeasing to us
O Allah, drive him away from us through our worship of You
And suppress him through our persistence in Your love

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِتْرًا لَا يَهْتِكُهُ
Translation: And place between us and him a covering that he cannot tear
And a solid barrier that he cannot breach

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And distract him from us with some of Your enemies

Arabic text: وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْهُ بِحُسْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ وَاكْفِنَا خَتْرَهُ
Translation: And protect us from him through Your excellent guardianship, and save us from his treachery
Turn his back to us and cut off his influence from us

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant us guidance equal to his misguidance
And provide us with piety contrary to his temptation

Arabic text: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا مِنَ التُّقَى خِلَافَ سَبِيلِهِ مِنَ الرَّدَى
Translation: And lead us on the path of righteousness opposite to his path of destruction

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُ فِيْ قُلُوبِنَا مَدْخَلًا
Translation: O Allah, do not give him an entrance into our hearts

Arabic text: وَلَا تُوطِنَنَّ لَهُ فِيمَا لَدَيْنَا مَنْزِلًا
Translation: And do not allow him to find a dwelling place in what we have

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَمَا سَوَّلَ لَنَا مِنْ بَاطِلٍ فَعَرِّفْنَاهُ
Translation: O Allah, whatever falsehood he has made appealing to us, make us recognize it

Arabic text: وَإِذَا عَرَّفْتَنَاهُ فَقِنَاهُ وَبَصِّرْنَا مَا نُكَايِدُهُ بِهِ
Translation: And when we recognize it, protect us from it, and show us how to counter his schemes

Arabic text: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَا نُعِدُّهُ لَهُ وَأَيْقِظْنَا عَنْ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ بِالرُّكُونِ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: And inspire us with what we should prepare against him, and awaken us from the slumber of heedlessness in relying on him
And through Your guidance, grant us excellent help against him
O Allah, fill our hearts with rejection of his works
And be gracious to us in dismantling his tricks

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَحَوِّلْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and remove his authority from us

Arabic text: وَاقْطَعْ رَجَاءَهُ مِنَّا وَادْرَأْهُ عَنِ الْوُلُوعِ بِنَا
Translation: Cut off his hope in us and prevent him from being obsessed with us

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And place our fathers, our mothers, our children, our families
Our relatives, our kinfolk, and our neighbors

Arabic text: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِنْهُ فِيْ حِرْزٍ حَارِزٍ
Translation: From among the believing men and women, in a secure refuge from him

Arabic text: وَحِصْنٍ حَافِظٍ وَكَهْفٍ مَانِعٍ وَأَلْبِسْهُمْ مِنْهُ جُنَنًا وَاقِيَةً
Translation: And in a protective fortress, and a sheltering cave, and clothe them with protective shields against him
And give them against him penetrating weapons

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مَنْ شَهِدَ لَكَ بِالرُّبُوبِيَّةِ
Translation: O Allah, extend this to all who acknowledge Your Lordship
And are sincere to You in affirming Your Oneness
And who oppose him for Your sake with the reality of servitude

Arabic text: وَاسْتَظْهَرَ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ فِيْ مَعْرِفَةِ الْعُلُومِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ
Translation: And who seek Your help against him in understanding the divine sciences

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ احْلُلْ مَا عَقَدَ وَافْتُقْ مَا رَتَقَ
Translation: O Allah, undo what he has tied, tear apart what he has mended

Arabic text: وَافْسَخْ مَا دَبَّرَ وَثَبِّطْهُ إِذَا عَزَمَ وَانْقُضْ مَا أَبْرَمَ
Translation: Nullify what he has devised, weaken his resolve when he determines, and unravel what he has affirmed
O Allah, defeat his troops and nullify his plot
Demolish his refuge and rub his nose in the dust
O Allah, place us among the ranks of his enemies
And remove us from the number of his friends
We will not obey him when he entices us
And we will not respond to him when he calls us
We command those who obey our orders to oppose him

Arabic text: وَنَعِظُ عَنْ مُتَابَعَتِهِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ زَجْرَنَا
Translation: And we admonish those who follow our prohibition against following him

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets and Master of the Messengers
And upon his household, the pure and the purified
And protect us, our families, and our brothers

Arabic text: وَجَمِيعَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِمَّا اسْتَعَذْنَا مِنْهُ
Translation: And all believing men and women from that which we seek refuge from

Arabic text: وَأَجِرْنَا مِمَّا اسْتَجَرْنَا بِكَ مِنْ خَوْفِهِ
Translation: And grant us protection from the fear of him which we have sought refuge from

Arabic text: وَاسْمَعْ لَنَا مَا دَعَوْنَا بِهِ وَأَعْطِنَا مَا أَغْفَلْنَاهُ وَاحْفَظْ لَنَا مَا نَسِينَاهُ
Translation: And hear what we have supplicated for, and grant us what we have neglected, and preserve for us what we have forgotten
And through this, elevate us to the ranks of the righteous
And to the stations of the believers
Amen, O Lord of the Worlds
